mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of comparison but it has no inherent significance of its own right."
The P/E ratio is a means of comparison but it has no inherent significance of its own right.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which covers both the basic money cost element as well as risk premium i.e additional return required to compensate for uncertainty (risk) associated with the investment."
The rate of discount is that which covers both the basic money cost element as well as risk premium i.e additional return required to compensate for uncertainty (risk) associated with the investment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the apex regulatory authority in the Nigerian Banking Sector."
The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) is the apex regulatory authority in the Nigerian Banking Sector.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the value created by bringing together of employees, customers, suppliers, managers and others in a mutually beneficial and productive relationship."
Organizational capital is the value created by bringing together of employees, customers, suppliers, managers and others in a mutually beneficial and productive relationship.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means a higher cost of raising equity funds if the firm sells additional common stock."
A lower stock price means a higher cost of raising equity funds if the firm sells additional common stock.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the simplest and the most widely used simplification and may be regarded as being at one extreme point of a continuum, with the Markowitz model at the other extreme point."
The single index model is the simplest and the most widely used simplification and may be regarded as being at one extreme point of a continuum, with the Markowitz model at the other extreme point.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most active sector on the floor of the Nigerian Stock Exchange with large volume of shares changing hands on daily basis with high degree of price volatility."
Equity trading is the most active sector on the floor of the Nigerian Stock Exchange with large volume of shares changing hands on daily basis with high degree of price volatility.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a variation of Price Momentum because it is calculated against the appropriate market or sector index."
Price Strength Price Strength is a variation of Price Momentum because it is calculated against the appropriate market or sector index.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the weighted average of the specific returns (alphas) of the individual securities."
The portfolio alpha is the weighted average of the specific returns (alphas) of the individual securities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the unique risk or unsystematic risk which can be reduced through diversification."
The specific risk component is the unique risk or unsystematic risk which can be reduced through diversification.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the appraisal of capital projects (Long-term assets) so as to enable management take decision on what asset to invest on most efficiently in anticipation of future earnings."
Capital budgeting is the appraisal of capital projects (Long-term assets) so as to enable management take decision on what asset to invest on most efficiently in anticipation of future earnings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the market for medium and long-term funds."
Capital market is the market for medium and long-term funds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an autonomous body which acts as an Supervisory authority over licensed banks."
The NDIC is an autonomous body which acts as an Supervisory authority over licensed banks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the recorded difference between the actual return and Rf+ B(Rm - Rf)."
Alpha factors is the recorded difference between the actual return and Rf+ B(Rm - Rf).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concave curve in the risk-return space that extends from the minimum variance portfolio to the maximum return portfolio."
The efficient frontier is a concave curve in the risk-return space that extends from the minimum variance portfolio to the maximum return portfolio.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are derived from the cumulative probabilities assigned for the possibilities."
The random numbers are derived from the cumulative probabilities assigned for the possibilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the possibility of an expected return not being realized."
Risk means the possibility of an expected return not being realized.
